solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Method of cooking meat in iron container

indicators.note: the meat is placed in the iron, which serves as the container around it

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron, here acting as the container
lamb is a kind of meat

explanation.surface: A cook describes preparing meat inside a cast-iron pot.
explanation.definitionFit: Flambé cooking douses food in spirit and sets it alight, a recognised technique in the kitchen.

clue.text: Be careful fastening hair

parts.note: fore is the golfer's warning shout to watch out
a lock is a fastening

explanation.surface: A warning to take care when clipping hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A lock of hair hanging over the forehead is a tuft of hair.

clue.text: Sceptic acting so badly

indicators.note: badly suggests the letters are put together wrongly, so rearranged

explanation.surface: A doubter performs poorly on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who holds that God's existence cannot be known is a religious sceptic.

clue.text: Drop one in the garden

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a bed is a planted area of the garden
a means one

explanation.surface: A single droplet falls in the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: A bead of sweat or dew is a small drop of liquid.

clue.text: Is in Paris holding shipment of French food

indicators.note: holding says the first word wraps around the second, keeping it within

parts.note: in French 'is' is est
cargo is a shipment of goods

explanation.surface: A Parisian receives a consignment of French delicacies.
explanation.definitionFit: Snails cooked in garlic butter are a classic dish of French cuisine.

clue.text: Bears entertaining dwarf with our kind of food

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, so the word for bears holds the other within it

parts.note: stands means bears or tolerates
wee means tiny, dwarf
taken as written

explanation.surface: Bears play host to a small creature, offering our kind of food.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chinese-style dish combining sugar and vinegar flavours is a style of cuisine.

clue.text: Fattest are prepared for a sensational finish

indicators.note: prepared suggests the letters have been made ready in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: The heaviest contestants are trained for a dramatic ending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sensational' refers to the senses, here taste, not drama.
explanation.definitionFit: The flavour lingering after eating or drinking is a closing impression on the palate.

clue.text: Greek devours the classics

parts.note: eats means devours

explanation.surface: A Greek gobbles up the ancient texts.
explanation.walkthrough: Greats is the name of the Oxford University degree in classics.
explanation.definitionFit: At Oxford the honours course in Latin, Greek and ancient philosophy goes by this name.

clue.text: Quake in Turkey — upheaval of capital

parts.note: TR is the international code for Turkey

indicators.note: upheaval suggests turning upside down, so in a down clue the word is read backwards

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy

explanation.surface: An earthquake in Turkey shakes up the capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremor is a shaking of the ground, a small earthquake.

clue.text: Fugitive loses article at airport

indicators.note: loses tells us to drop a piece from the word for fugitive

parts.note: a runaway is a fugitive
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An escaped prisoner is caught losing something at the airport.
explanation.definitionFit: The strip where planes land and take off is found at any airport.

clue.text: Connoisseur ate these uneasily

indicators.note: uneasily suggests the letters of the two words are restless and rearranged

explanation.surface: A gourmet eats some dishes with discomfort.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone of refined artistic taste is a connoisseur of beauty.

clue.text: Dad had engine modified showing ulterior motive

indicators.note: modified suggests the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Father tinkered with his car engine for a secret reason.
explanation.definitionFit: A concealed purpose behind one's actions is a hidden plan or ulterior motive.

clue.text: Female section of the National Assembly

indicators.note: section of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A woman sits in one part of a parliament's chamber.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl or young woman is a female, especially in Scottish and northern English usage.

clue.text: Dye old predator in retreat of old master

parts.note: tint means dye

indicators.note: in retreat means going backwards, so this word is read in reverse

parts.note: an otter is a predator of fish

explanation.surface: An art restorer stains a picture of an ageing hunter backing away.
explanation.definitionFit: Tintoretto was a sixteenth-century Venetian painter, so a great painter of the past.

clue.text: Shortages damage urban areas

parts.note: to scar is to damage
cities are urban areas

explanation.surface: Supply shortfalls are harming towns.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarcities are situations where something is in short supply, so shortages.

clue.text: Unplanned confrontation with American during depression

indicators.note: during places these pieces within the time span, so inside, the word for depression

parts.note: a col is a dip or pass between mountain peaks
an incident can be a hostile clash or confrontation

explanation.surface: A spontaneous clash with a US citizen happened during an economic slump.
explanation.definitionFit: Something happening by chance rather than design is accidental, not planned.

clue.text: Priest is buried in concrete for revenge

indicators.note: buried in means set deep inside another word

parts.note: real means concrete, actual
taken as written

explanation.surface: A cleric has been entombed in cement as an act of vengeance.
explanation.definitionFit: An act of retaliation for a wrong suffered is a form of revenge.

clue.text: Inscrutable Tories assembled in the city

indicators.note: in tells us the shuffled letters sit inside the code for the city

parts.note: EC is the postcode area of the City of London

indicators.note: assembled suggests the letters are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: Mysterious Conservatives gathered in the financial district.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's financial district, whose postcodes begin EC.
explanation.definitionFit: Something understood only by a few initiates is obscure and hard to fathom.

clue.text: Trustee to destroy dogs? They lead the way!

parts.note: T is an abbreviation for trustee
to rend is to tear apart or destroy
setters are a breed of gun dog

explanation.surface: A trustee is told to put down dogs, who seem to be in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: The dogs that 'lead the way' might be guide dogs, but here they are setters, and the leaders are fashion pioneers.
explanation.definitionFit: People who start new fashions are followed by others, so they show the way.

clue.text: Responsibility of Welsh rowing team

parts.note: an eight is a racing boat crew of eight oarsmen

explanation.surface: A burden borne by a crew of Welsh rowers.
explanation.definitionFit: A weight on one's shoulders is a burden or responsibility.

clue.text: Condition of soldier's mate

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, stands for a soldier
to pair is to mate, and a pair is a couple of mates

explanation.surface: A query about the state of a soldier's friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Repair can mean state, as in a house 'in good repair', so physical condition.

clue.text: Trip in the dark when just at home with complaint

parts.note: even can mean just, as in 'even now'
in means at home
gout is a painful medical complaint

explanation.surface: Someone stumbles at night while stuck indoors with an ailment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trip' looks like a stumble; it is an outing.
explanation.definitionFit: A night spent out at a show or restaurant is a social excursion after dusk.

clue.text: Run as a communist

definitions.meaning: to jog or go at a gentle running pace
short for a follower of Leon Trotsky, a revolutionary Marxist

explanation.surface: Someone canvasses as a left-wing candidate.
explanation.definitionFit: One word means both a jogging pace and a Trotskyist, a type of left-wing revolutionary.

clue.text: Inclination to be dishonest

explanation.surface: Someone has a tendency towards being crooked.
explanation.definitionFit: One word means both a natural aptitude and, as slang, crooked or corrupt.

clue.text: Incline to stop in allotment

indicators.note: in places the word for stopping within the word for allotment

parts.note: a grant is an allotment of money or land
to die is to stop, as an engine does

explanation.surface: Someone is told to halt on a garden plot that slopes.
explanation.walkthrough: An allotment is a small rented plot of land for growing vegetables in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A slope's steepness, or the slope itself, is an incline.

clue.text: Landlord's short of gold

parts.note: less means minus or short of
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A property owner is running low on money.
explanation.definitionFit: The party who lets out property under a lease is a landlord.

clue.text: Fatigues one like a blind prophet

parts.note: tires means fatigues, wears out
I is the Roman numeral for one
as means like

explanation.surface: Someone wearing army fatigues resembles a sightless seer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fatigues' reads as army clothing but is the verb meaning wears out.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth, Tiresias was the sightless seer of Thebes.

clue.text: Character with inclination for one toiletry containing iodine

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: containing means the powder's word holds the element's symbol

parts.note: talc is a toiletry powder
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: A person's leaning towards one bathroom product laced with iodine.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloping type is a style of printed lettering that leans to the right.
